title: With Jensen Huang’s Return as C.E.O., Trump Effectively Overrode Nvidia’s Board
summary: Nvidia’s board said Mr. Huang would not be back. But President Trump, who pushed for Mr. Huang’s reinstatement, effectively overrode the board, governance experts said.
